def test_file_access(filename)
  base_path = "/var/songs/"
  full_path = File.join(base_path, filename)

  if File.exist?(full_path)
    puts "File exists: #{full_path}"
  else
    puts "File does not exist: #{full_path}"
  end
end

# Example usage
